judgement.reason: Superset runs as one web image with Celery workers on PostgreSQL and Redis; the websocket and node services are optional development add-ons, so the outcome with changes is not too lenient.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: docker-compose.yml defines 3 application services (superset, superset-websocket, superset-node). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: The docker-compose.yml stack is a development setup that builds the dev target with DEV_MODE on, and the file says it is not supported for production, so its extra services do not describe the production app.

evidence.quote: # We don't support docker compose for production environments.
